overview: A bold, immersive journalism series diving into Quebec's hottest, most controversial topics to shine a light on hidden realities, contradictions, and overlooked voices. Entre les lignes explores intense subjects, including the battle against adult websites, the exploitation of underaged victims, the rise of religious influencers, and the mental health crises among emergency responders.
title: Entre les lignes

overview: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.
title: TFI Unplugged

overview: Former football player Phil is forced to leave professional sports after a serious injury and take a job as a history teacher. However, his career at the school doesn't last long: due to his overly unconventional teaching methods, Phil is fired. To earn money for an expensive operation and get back into football, he starts tutoring with a friend, even agreeing to the most dubious offers. One day, they get an unusual student — the 13‑year‑old son of the crime boss Lemur. The teenager dreams of following in his father's footsteps and already thinks like a real mafioso. Now Phil not only has to find a way to connect with the difficult child but also help the district police officer's daughter get into MGIMO, despite her strict father's resistance.
title: Трудный ребёнок

overview: India's Got Latent is an offbeat comedy talent show where aspiring performers showcase their most unconventional and hidden "latent" talents. Instead of seeking traditional approval, contestants win by proving how self-aware they are, as they must accurately predict the average score the celebrity judges will give them. Hosted by comedian Samay Raina, the show pivots away from conventional reality TV by emphasizing humor, internet culture, and lighthearted, roaster-style critique from a rotating panel of special guests.
title: India's Got Latent

overview: With first hand accounts and commentary from medical professionals, each half-hour episode sends viewers on an unrestricted journey into an entirely new world of sex. The focus of the show will be bizarre conditions, such as the fictional sex addiction, fetishes and kinky sexual behavior. An Iraq war veteran who only experiences pain during intercourse and a former Broadway star and sex educator who learned to "think" herself into having an orgasm would be some of the cases featured in the series. Other examples are someone with balloon fetish and a woman who wants orgasm during childbirth.
title: Strange Sex

overview: Live coverage of the FIA World Rallycross Championships.
title: FIA World Rallycross Championship Live

overview: Subscription Adultery follows an ordinary housewife trapped in an emotionally distant marriage who falls into the dangerous, secretive, and addictive world of an "adultery subscription service" app.
title: Subscription Adultery

overview: Set in a near-future Japan, a new drug dubbed DOPE, is rampant on the streets and shrouded in secrecy. Rookie narcotics officer Saiki, suddenly gets transferred to a special investigation unit whose existence is not known to the public. He meets his new partner Jinnai, his mentor, but the two couldn't be more different - and it shows. Saiki, the serious one, believes in rehabilitating criminals, while Jinnai takes a looser, unconventional approach. Along with their quirky team, the two take on the country's new drug epidemic in this narcotics action-adventure.
title: DOPE: Narcotics Control Department Special Investigations Unit

overview: Kaede Ikushima and Jun Ichinose, a couple living together for nearly a year, appear happy but hide lies from each other. Their seemingly perfect life unravels, leading to a dramatic transformation.
title: Foresuto

overview: Stingers: Undercover Verification Unit follows an unconventional police team that navigates the legal gray areas of modern crime by carrying out deep undercover operations. Led by an FBI-trained specialist, former criminals and police work together using disguises and psychological manipulation to infiltrate and expose high-stakes syndicates from within
title: Stingers: Undercover Verification Unit

overview: During her lunch break, game designer Naho Karashima accidentally ruins Haru Amami's vintage clothes with spilled coffee. Unable to repay him, she agrees to make him homemade lunches for 30 days. Their unusual park "dates" slowly turn into something more—until Naho discovers Haru is a creator at a rival company, threatening both their budding connection and their careers.
title: Lunch Break Lovers

overview: Domon Makoto used to work at a forensic science laboratory. He was the ace there and, with his high level of appraisal skills, was known as the Last Appraiser. Due to a case, he quit his job at the forensic science laboratory. Now, he runs his own appraisal office. He works with researcher Takakura Shuko, who is a psychology expert. They receive requests for scientific investigations from the police and judicial officials. The cases are difficult to solve, but they work diligently using a scientific approach.
title: Last-Resort Investigator

overview: Aces: The ATP No. 1 Club is a series that follows the stories, rivalries, sacrifices, and defining moments behind the 29 men who reached the top of men's professional tennis and earned the World No. 1 ranking. Rather than focusing only on trophies and statistics, the series looks at what it actually took to stay at the top across different eras of the sport. Across four episodes, the series moves through decades of changing playing styles, growing global competition, and the constant pressure that comes with becoming the best player in the world. From the early pioneers of the rankings era through the dominance of the modern legends and into the rise of a new generation, the series explores how each No. 1 left a mark on tennis history.
title: Aces: The ATP No. 1 Club

overview: The two heroes of the police department, Luo Song and Gao Chuan, encounter a series of events as they investigate the accidental death of their master, Cheng Fenguha. After Cheng Fenghua's passing, Gao Chuan leaves the force but is still obsessed with the truth of the car crash that took his master away. A series of mysteries finally make Luo Song start to believe that there is more to that accident. The duo joins hands once again after many years, but they are unknowingly stepping into a deadly mystery.
title: Zhi nian ru ying

overview: Play Away is a British television children's programme. A sister programme to the infants' series Play School, it was aimed at slightly older children. It ran from 1971 until 1984, and was broadcast on Saturday afternoons on BBC 2. The format was a little like a music-hall variety show or 'end-of-the-pier' show. The Musical Director was Jonathan Cohen on piano, with Spike Heatley on double bass and Alan Rushton on drums, often with accomplished guest musicians such as trombonist George Chisholm. Regular 'Players' throughout the thirteen-year run included familiar Play School presenters such as Brian Cant, Toni Arthur, Derek Griffiths,Lionel Morton, Chloe Ashcroft, Floella Benjamin, Johnny Ball, Carol Chell and Julie Stevens.
title: Play Away
The Night I Got Pregnant by the CEO

overview: Celebrating culture's iconic and consequential moments of the year; with more than 100 unique award categories, musical performances and celebrity guests, this show brings culture to life.
title: Las Culturistas Culture Awards

overview: A group of individuals becomes cyber protectors against modern digital threats. Cybercrime investigations with field operations, intense combat scenes, and technologically driven missions.
title: Taskforce Firewall

overview: After losing both his girlfriend and his curling team, disgraced curler Connor sets out to seduce his ex-girlfriend Ivy's billionaire fiancé, star hockey captain Hunter, to sabotage their engagement, only to find himself genuinely falling in love as manipulation turns into something real.
title: Seducing My Hockey Rival

overview: A fictitious department "Finger" established within the Metropolitan Police Department to deal with the social problem of keyboard murder = finger murder, in which the victim commits suicide in the worst case, suffering from slander and burning on the Internet.
title: Anonymous
Can't Write! A Life Without Scenario

overview: The weekly show from the Official Doctor Who YouTube channel. Friends of The Doctor and curators of Doctor Who news, here you will see all of our un-seen bonus videos and lots of extra stuff from our presenter Christel Dee.
title: Doctor Who: The Fan Show
Don't Fight With Fools Even When You Get Pissed Off!

overview: Hideki Kaji, the brilliant yet money-loving "Wizard of Laparoscopy," navigates difficult medical cases, corruption, and bizarre situations. Demoted and working in regional or rural hospitals, this Doctor-X spin-off follows the arrogant surgeon as he balances his greed with his undeniable medical talent.
title: Doctor-Y: Surgeon Hideki Kaji

overview: The Wargame takes viewers beyond the news cycle and behind closed doors into a sealed COBR-style crisis room where real-world senior politicians, military leaders and intelligence chiefs are challenged to confront a high-stakes scenario: a Russian attack on UK soil. Set six months in the future, this gripping simulation has been developed in conjunction with leading academics, military and defence experts, including Sky News' Security and Defence Editor Deborah Haynes, to replicate the pressure of political decision-making at the highest level. Rolling news bulletins, social media footage, military and intelligence reports and unexpected interventions throw up a series of minute-by-minute dilemmas, forcing the ‘Cabinet' to grapple with decisions that could affect us all. A provocative stress test on our leaders, our institutions and the country itself, this unmissable event television will prompt us all to engage with our new geopolitical reality.
title: The Wargame

overview: Virtual crime scene recreations help investigators look back into the past to solve mysteries.
title: Celebrity Crime Scene

overview: Adaptation of Flora Thompson's memoir of her Oxfordshire childhood, set in the small hamlet of Lark Rise and the wealthier neighbouring market town, Candleford, at the end of the 19th Century.
title: Lark Rise to Candleford

overview: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.
title: The Love Lab

overview: 1828. The restored monarchy teeters on the brink, a new revolution is brewing. In this turbulent France, Julien Sorel, a poor carpenter's son, is ready to do anything to climb the social ladder. Torn between the Red and the Black, between military ambition and an ecclesiastical career, but also between two women who are complete opposites, he will have to pay the price for his choices.
title: Le Rouge et le Noir

overview: Zhou Jing'an, a wealthy heir concealing his passion for music, crosses paths with Li Xingyao, a guarded musician raised in an orphanage. Connecting through late-night masked music uploads and tender, hidden gestures, the two navigate past wounds to melt each other's defenses and embark on a journey of love and healing.
title: Blazing Him

overview: Forensic anthropologist Nora Becker has traveled the world exploring the mysteries of the past. When Nora becomes the guardian of Sam, a 12-year-old girl, she is forced to return to her childhood town, Chambéry. She finds her new purpose when she meets Commander Gil Spinelli, solving complex and fascinating cases.
title: Les aventures de Nora & Gil

overview: Centered on the intangible cultural heritage of Xuan paper-making, this series follows Xuan Yan, a heir to the craft, and Lin Yiran, a local official who has returned to her hometown. Together in Taohua Town, they navigate the delicate balance between preserving ancient techniques and embracing modern innovation. As they reconcile the clashes between two generations of master craftsmen and break through industrial bottlenecks, they forge a new path for rural revitalization, keeping the thousand-year legacy of Xuan paper alive for generations to come.
title: Where the Ink Takes Root

overview: In the fall of 2022, four University of Idaho students were found murdered in an off-campus house in the quiet college town of Moscow. As fear spread through the community, investigators faced intense pressure to solve a case marked by few immediate answers. This new documentary unpacks the chilling crime, the investigation that followed, and the lasting impact on a town forever changed.
title: The Idaho Murders: A College Town Nightmare

overview: Life of Isabella I of Castile, also known as Isabella the Catholic.
title: Isabel

overview: Alliance is a competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points - the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.
title: Alliance

overview: The SSBC (Sousa Sien Bunseki Center), also known as the Crime Support and Analysis Center, has a newly established violent crimes department. Their job is to collect and analyze CCTV footage, smartphones, computers, and profile criminals. They provide specialized support for the First Criminal Investigation Division.
title: Dai-Tsuiseki Keisihcho SSBC Kyôkôhan-Gakari

overview: Claudia, an ambitious young bi‑racial lawyer, travels to Jamaica to challenge an inheritance claim made by a local man, Cudjoe East, against Oliver Connaught, a wealthy white aristocrat. But the case takes an unsettling turn when Claudia discovers that the disputed estate is the very place that has haunted her nightmares: Hope Hill, the Connaught family's former plantation. As Claudia and Oliver dig deeper, they uncover a disturbing link between the plantation's brutal past and the injustices still shaping the present.
title: Possession

overview: Alexander Armstrong embarks on a journey across the United States to explore how a nation founded on bold ideals has grown into one of the world's most powerful and complex countries. From historic heartlands to modern extremes, this is a country shaped by its past but constantly reinventing itself.
title: Alexander Armstrong Across America

overview: Katie Nicholl and Jo Elvin host this new show that pulls back the velvet curtain on the world's most famous family with fearless debate, insider analysis and exclusive insights.
title: The Royals: Uncensored

overview: At the height of Brazil's military dictatorship, a flight would change the fate of everyone on board. Among the passengers were a mother, her two young children, and militants from VAR-Palmares with a daring plan: to divert Flight 114 to Cuba. Caravelle 114 reconstructs, in fiction, the events behind the hijacking that defied the Brazilian dictatorship.
title: Caravelle 114

overview: This three-part documentary reveals the explosive true story that inspired The Wolf of Wall Street.
title: The Real Wolf of Wall Street

overview: Hot Ones: Extra Heat challenges celebrity guests to answer spicy questions while eating even spicier wings.
title: Hot Ones: Extra Heat

overview: The Drop follows Wanda and Leon (from the original Snowfall series), who are now fighting to reinvent themselves in '90s Los Angeles, where the fallout from the crack epidemic is fueling a new game: the rise of West Coast rap.
title: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga

overview: After her father's death, Lika Lunina's quiet life changes overnight. She discovers that her parents are not her biological ones. Leaving home, Lika sets out to find her real parents, who lost her during the turbulent days of the 1991 coup. The task seems impossible, but love will help her unravel the mystery…
title: Огни большого города

overview: investigative program presented by Chaim Etgar, which exposes a long line of serial imposters, all of whom have one thing in common: they have tricked a large number of victims. Each episode will feature a chase after a different imposter.
title: HaMithazim

overview: The Luján Zamudio family appears perfect until a tragedy reveals that nothing is as it seems. On the night of Beatriz's birthday, the matriarch behind the Prestigio Hotel and Mexico's largest floral empire, the celebration ends in horror when her body falls from her room. What initially appears to be a suicide soon uncovers an even more disturbing truth: Beatriz was poisoned with pollen, a lethal substance. Jacobo, her favorite son, returns after years away, determined to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, prosecutor Sandra Fitzgerald faces a family where everyone is hiding something: ambitious children, resentful ex-husbands, and dangerous partners. Amid poisonous flowers, unexpected alliances, forbidden romances, and long-buried secrets, no one is safe.
title: Polen

overview: Police, drug lords, undercover agents, and spies—all layers of the power system are collapsing. Behind a seemingly lawful police hierarchy lies a city controlled by corruption, desire, and hidden power games, where human lives are only bargaining chips. A mysterious kidnapping exposes a buried network of crimes, unraveling misaligned identities, systemic corruption, and a long-suppressed past. Love and sex become tools of control and exchange. And the real chaos began ten years ago, within a forgotten relationship that never truly ended.
title: Sin and Love

overview: Vicky's on the verge of turning 40, and she can't help envying those who seem to have everything she once dreamed of. But an unexpected turn in her life will send her on a wildly chaotic journey filled with new romance, revelations from the past, and surprising encounters.
title: Troppo Invidiosa

overview: Anthony Blake was falsely held prisoner in a South American prison. Using his skills, he managed to escape and then swore that he'd help people who faced the kind of injustice that he faced. Now as a touring magician, Anthony helps those who need help using his talents for sleight-of-hand and escapology.
title: The Magician

overview: For thirteen years, Nam Da Reum has been a dedicated fan of idol star Lee Chan. When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi. .
title: My Bias, My Boss

overview: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse is a classic 1950–1952 dramatic anthology series that featured weekly adaptations of Pulitzer Prize-winning plays, novels, and stories. Hosted and narrated by journalist Elmer Davis, the television program brought prestigious literary and theatrical works to the growing American medium.
title: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse

overview: 30 years after his landmark debut album "Reasonable Doubt," artist, icon, philanthropist, entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career, revisiting the music together and unpacking his work and life through a shared listening and illuminating conversation. Featuring many of JAŸ-Z's iconic tracks and album cuts, including "99 Problems," "Brooklyn's Finest," and "4:44," the eight-episode series offers a deeply revealing portrait of the artist and his work, exploring the influences and inspiration that shaped both the man and his music.
title: JAŸ-Z IN 8

overview: The Wolf King follows princess Aurora, after being abducted by a brooding werewolf alpha from a world that treated her as a decorative pawn, uncovering her own wild strength. Ensnared in a lethal love triangle, she is thrust into a bloodthirsty war between humankind and her feral captors, forcing her to decide whether she's a prize to be claimed or the master of her own destiny.
title: The Wolf King

overview: When teenaged Coral moves to a dreamy seaside town, she begins unraveling the truth behind her mother's disappearance—and discovers her mother was a mermaid, awakening magical powers in Coral just as secrets beneath the waves threaten to surface.
title: Aquamarine

overview: The story of immigrants from Ulster who played a critical role in America's break from Britain.
title: Declaration

overview: Terror on the Space Station is a gripping exploration of life aboard the most dangerous construction site in human history. Hurtling around Earth at 17,000mph, the International Space Station is protected only by thin metal walls, shielding astronauts from the most hostile environment humans have ever endured. In this high-stakes documentary, international astronauts, along with mission controllers, recount the ISS's most terrifying moments - from toxic gas leaks and meteor strikes to spacewalk crises, faulty spacesuits, docking disasters, rogue satellites, and the heart-stopping incident when the entire station spun wildly out of control. These are stories of survival, split-second decisions, and the brilliance that kept them alive 250 miles above Earth.
title: Terror on the Space Station

overview: Rev Run is embarking on his next adventure, but this time with his family. After spending years traveling the world with band mates, Rev Run is embarking on his next travel adventure, but this time with his family. Equipped with four round-the-world tickets, Rev and family will brave exotic territories, fascinating cultures, and much more on Travel Channel's Rev Runs Around the World.
title: Rev Runs Around the World

overview: Being a truck driver isn't easy - long hours, huge loads and busy roads are just some of the issues. Truckers from Germany, Italy and Holland share their journeys.
title: Mighty Truckers

overview: Varya and Michael finally move into their own house and are ready for a happy life, but everything changes after the tragic incident with Varya's patient, after which she ends up in a sect. Anton and Marina decide to have a baby and go through a difficult IVF path, which forces Anton to completely change his usual lifestyle. Valya and Masha face a new challenge after an accident: Valya loses his eyesight, and the family has to learn to live in new circumstances. Kristina, after failures in her personal life, decides to focus on her son and business, but unexpectedly meets two men at once who return her feeling of care and support. And Alla and Kuzi begin a new stage of family life: after the birth of their son Makar, they have to re-assign roles in the family, which leads to conflicts and a struggle for business.
title: Универ. 17 лет спустя

overview: SS-Lieutenant Colonel Helmut Von Schreader conceives an unusual plan to escape the aftermath of the Second World War by disguising himself as a Jewish Concentration Camp victim. Under the alias of Ben Grossman, Von Schreader is liberated from the camps and immigrates to Palestine where he joins the Zionist movement.
title: Twist of Fate

overview: Six months after the deadly events of The Master Plan, underworld negotiator Kida drifts through life until he is reluctantly drawn into a new case to save a childhood friend. His mission connects him with a mysterious woman, Michiru, whose favorite phrase hints at a deeper connection to Kida's past.
title: Re: The End of the Tiny World: Half A Year Later

overview: Drag Race México: Latina Royale brings together 11 queens from across Latin America for a glamorous battle for the crown, with Mexico as the season's proud host. Led by Taiga Brava and Lolita Banana, the competition serves up talent, fashion, comedy, music, and delicious telenovela-style rivalry across 10 episodes packed with flavor, spectacle, and drama.
title: Drag Race México: Latina Royale

overview: Undercover officer Mo Feihuan unexpectedly crosses paths with Xu Luetao, the CEO of Tianping Group. Drawn together by fate, both men hide behind carefully crafted masks and dangerous secrets. As their true identities are gradually revealed, sweetness turns into suspicion, and even the deepest devotion seems destined to fail. A single careless remark from Xu Luetao shatters their fragile bond. Meanwhile, a major cross-border counterfeit operation exposes a brutal power struggle among local forces, drawing both the underworld and the police into a deadly game. Caught in the eye of the storm, Mo Feihuan and Xu Luetao find that the only person they can truly trust is each other. With every step leading deeper into danger and every moment apart deepening their longing, they stand together against overwhelming odds. Though divided by opposing worlds, their hearts remain destined for the same path.
title: Ash
Wong Fei-hung: Curse of the Voodoo Spirits

overview: Su Wan, a university student majoring in animal psychology, has loved animals since childhood and cannot bear to see them harmed. One day, she learns that a group of dogs has been trafficked by a criminal gang. Determined to save them, she follows a trail of clues alone to the gang's hideout, despite the risks to her own safety. Outnumbered and quickly discovered, Su Wan finds herself in grave danger as the criminals close in. Just when all hope seems lost, a familiar yet unfamiliar figure appears and subdues the gang, rescuing her. To Su Wan's astonishment, the mysterious young man is Ye Tianyu—her childhood companion who has been separated from her for sixteen years. Once inseparable, the two were torn apart by unexpected circumstances. Their dramatic reunion rekindles a long-lost connection and brings their lives together once again.
title: Summer Serendipity

overview: Experts join Bob Massi to provide insight and expertise on the real estate market on Bob Massi is the Property Man.
title: Bob Massi is the Property Man

overview: Spring at Qiongzhou University is shattered when Li Weihao, a design student, leaps to his death. Rejected by the girl he loved, tormented by relentless campus bullying, betrayed by his parents, and stripped of his dreams, he chooses to end his life. His death becomes a mirror, exposing the darkest secrets hidden within everyone around him. His childhood friend Zhang Chao is forced to confront long-buried trauma, triggering the emergence of a ten-year-old alternate personality within him. Psychologist Chen Rong, haunted by guilt over failing to respond to Li Weihao's desperate plea for help in time, joins the investigation. Bai Qiu, the girl Li secretly loved, risks infiltrating influencer Zhu Xiaoyu's illegal trafficking network to uncover the truth behind her best friend Shasha's suspicious car crash. Meanwhile, former bully Lin Jiaming struggles under the oppressive control of his authoritarian father, Lin Yongtai. As the investigation unfolds, a web of campus bullying, corruption, sexual exploitation, and drug-facilitated assaults is gradually brought to light, all leading to the vast criminal empire secretly orchestrated by billionaire Lin Yongtai.
title: The Forbidden Land

overview: Irene is the perfect secretary—a dream come true for any executive: intelligent, efficient, and absolutely reliable. Yet, despite her impressive skills, she is an introverted young woman with low self-esteem, leading her to believe she holds no romantic appeal for men. This personal insecurity has driven her to focus intensely on her work, fueled by a strong desire for professional success. Over time—and almost without realizing it—Irene falls in love with her boss, Leonardo Ferrandiz, a millionaire widower raising five children on his own; he is far too busy to notice his secretary's feelings. Irene's secret love and deep sense of responsibility compel her to go to great lengths and endure significant challenges to ensure Leonardo's happiness—such as acting as a surrogate mother to his children and resolving countless issues, not only at the office but also within the Ferrandiz household. Through her loyalty and dedication, Irene gradually earns her boss's admiration, as well as the respect and affection of his children. In the process, these experiences help transform her into a different woman—more confident and assertive—capable of winning Leonardo's love.
title: Amor Secreto

overview: Travel host, stunt woman and sustainability expert Alice Ford explores some of our world's most awe-inspiring natural wonders; national parks, forests, mountain ranges, beaches and deserts. Find the adventure in nature, around the world and in our own backyard.
title: Alice's Adventures on Earth

overview: Pentor is a sit-com about modern working singles who are looking for their soul mates. It is centered on the busy life of Mr. Pentor, who is a businessman in the BKL company. He wants to have an easy life and just wants to be a normal businessman like other people in Bangkok. However, what he wants is never what he gets.
title: Pen Tor

overview: A declining birthrate, shortage of doctors, and a wave of maternity ward closures in rural areas. In modern Japan, the front lines of childbirth—the very place meant to protect mothers and babies—are facing an unprecedented crisis. Even perinatal medical centers, responsible for handling high-risk pregnancies, are reaching their limits in accepting emergency cases. Amid this harsh reality, a secret team is formed under the direct orders of the hospital director at one of Japan's most prestigious, high-end hospitals in Tokyo. They are known as "Maternal and Neonatal Emergency Medical Unit." Their mission is to save pregnant women with complex circumstances who have nowhere else to go—completely free of charge. The key member of this team is Aki Mitsui, a highly skilled obstetrician-gynecologist. Despite partial hearing loss in one ear, she is a self-made specialist who is more obsessed with hearing a baby's first cry than anyone else. Can Aki and her team become the last line of defense, saving lives hanging in the balance? Set behind the scenes of a glamorous celebrity hospital, this medical entertainment drama depicts the fierce struggles of the elite unit as they fight to protect new life!
title: First Cry

overview: Set in the culturally diverse Ueno district of Tokyo, the story follows Eiko Yagami, a beautiful and dangerous detective in the Organized Crime Countermeasures Division (colloquially known as "Marubo"). Breaking all the rules, Yagami doesn't hesitate to use violence or ally with the Yakuza and the Chinese mafia. Her ultimate, driving goal is to uncover the truth behind the murder of her husband—a freelance journalist who dug too deep into the criminal underworld.
title: Yagami Eiko: Ueno Chuo Police Station Organized Crime Countermeasures Division

overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."
title: Mousetrap

overview: This contemporary series follows three automotive appraisers as they cruise across America in search of often rare, super inviting, and always interesting automotive finds. Featuring Tom Cox, the Classic Car Guy, Chris Ritter, the Car Geek, and Ben Nef, the Vegas High Roller, each episode introduces viewers to passionate characters who make up the auto enthusiast world, and the excitement builds as The Appraisers reveal how much each owner's pride and joy is worth. The Appraisers covers it all - antiques, classics, muscle, luxury and exotic cars, old trucks, motorcycles and automotive memorabilia - and each collective episode adds up to a great time for all.
title: The Appraisers

overview: Following the sole survivor of a random mass stabbing who is given a mysterious 10-day ultimatum to live, three unlikely allies—a determined detective, an investigative reporter, and the targeted survivor—risk everything to unravel the truth behind a shocking conspiracy hiding in the dark heart of Japanese society.
title: Hanzaisha

overview: A love story between Ichinose Aoi, a 49 year old woman who has experienced all kinds of ups and downs in life, such as marriage, divorce, failures, and Higuchi Subaru, a 30 year old man who gave up on his dreams due o his upbringing and has been living without his emotions. One day, Aoi meets Subaru due to a problem involving her best friend. Despite the difference in age and background, the two gradually come to understand each other and find themselves drawn towards each other.
title: Last Note

overview: My Fiction follows Masaki Igawa, an ordinary caregiver who slips into a coma after an accident. When he wakes up a week later, he returns home to find an imposter living his life—and his colleagues, neighbors, and even his wife, Mayumi, have entirely forgotten him.
title: My Fiction

overview: On June 22, 1941, the life of every Soviet citizen was split into "before" and "after." How did the world plunge into the abyss of the Second World War? Why did the West allow fascism to triumph? What did the Soviet Union do to prevent the war? You will find the answers in the documentary series *Invasion*.
title: Вторжение
